0022600033.text: The Sacramento Kings host the San Antonio Spurs in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game and are 1-7 overall, 0-3 at home, and 15th in the West, while the Spurs are 6-2 and riding a six-game winning streak in 6th in the West. The season series stands at 0-1 in favor of the Spurs for 2026-27, after San Antonio won 130-103 at home on October 27, and the Kings also lost all three meetings in 2025-26. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
